svg.aria-label: One slide at a time. Write notes in Markdown with a line of --- between slides. Headings work too, so a Word or PDF script converts in a minute. ⌃⌥→ and ⌃⌥← from any app.
svg.text: Write notes in Markdown with a line of ---
between slides. Headings work too, so a Word
or PDF script converts in a minute.
